name: Popover
summary: An anchored surface beside its button that can hold controls: contextual help with a link (the toggletip), a short form or a set of filters, a confirmation by its button. It opens on a press, never on hover, and doesn't block the page. Not for a hint without controls (use Tooltip), for a choice from a list (use Select or MenuButton), or for anything that must be answered before going on (use Dialog).
a11y: The trigger is a Button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The popover is a non-modal `role="dialog"` named by its title (or the trigger's label) in the top layer, placed by the shared anchor rule (flips and shifts to stay in the window). Opening moves focus to its first control, or to the surface itself when it has none, so its words are read. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger; a press outside or Tab past its last control closes it and leaves focus where it went. Opening fades in; with reduced motion it appears at once.

keys.keys: Enter or Space on the trigger

keys.action: closes it; focus returns to the trigger
moves through its controls; past the last one it closes and focus moves on

props.name: trigger
props.description: The Button that opens and closes it; it shows as expanded while open.

props.name: title
props.description: A short heading inside: the popover's accessible name. Without one, it's named by the trigger's label.

props.name: children
props.description: What it holds: a few words of help with a link, a short form, filters, a confirmation's question and Buttons.

props.name: side
props.description: The side it prefers; it flips when there's no room there. Default `bottom`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled: shown while true. Leave out to let the trigger open and close it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Asked to open or close: the trigger, Escape, a press outside, or focus leaving.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's words, or the accessible name of an icon-only button: "Filters", "About this field".
